text_002.en: For research collaboration, thermal measurement inquiries, student opportunities, or general questions, please contact the laboratory.
text_002.zh: 如需开展科研合作、交流测试需求、了解学生机会或提出一般问题，请联系实验室。

text_009.en: Micro-Nano Electronics Building, 5 Yiheyuan Road, Haidian District, Beijing 100871
text_009.zh: 微纳电子大厦, 北京市海淀区颐和园路5号，邮编100871

text_013.en: Please include a brief description of your sample, measurement objective, expected thermal property, sample structure, and available supporting information.
text_013.zh: 来信请简要说明样品、测量目标、拟测热学参数、样品结构及已有辅助信息。

text_015.en: Approximate film thickness or device geometry
text_015.zh: 薄膜大致厚度或器件几何结构

text_016.en: Target property: thermal conductivity, thermal boundary conductance, or thermal resistance
text_016.zh: 目标参数：热导率、界面热导或热阻

text_017.en: Available images, process information, or previous measurement data
text_017.zh: 已有图像、工艺信息或历史测量数据

text_018.zh: 预期时间安排与合作目的

text_026.en: Students interested in thermal metrology, semiconductor devices, optics, heat transfer, data analysis, and scientific computing are welcome to contact us.
text_026.zh: 欢迎对热测试、半导体器件、光学、传热、数据分析和科学计算感兴趣的学生联系我们。

text_029.en: Micro-Nano Electronics Building, Peking University, 5 Yiheyuan Road, Haidian District, Beijing 100871, China
text_029.zh: 北京市海淀区颐和园路5号北京大学微纳电子大厦，邮编 100871

text_031.en: Take Line 4 to Peking University East Gate Station (北京大学东门站), enter through the campus East Gate, and walk about 10 minutes to the building.
text_031.zh: 乘坐地铁4号线至北京大学东门站，由校园东门入校后步行约10分钟即可到达微纳电子大厦。

text_033.en: The building is inside the PKU campus. Visitors are kindly asked to contact us in advance so campus entry can be arranged.
text_033.zh: 大厦位于北京大学校园内，来访前请提前与我们联系，以便协助安排入校事宜。
